_meta.bumpRule: Any change to the subject GRANT semantics (subjects, allow/deny) is a breaking change: bump to nats-permissions.v2.json and update BOTH the plugin parity test and the saas JWT-claim parity test in the same commit. Parity comparisons strip _meta first.
_meta.notes: accountId is NOT present in any grant — the browser grant wildcards the accountId segment (webchannel.{tenant}.*.{peerId}.>) so one peerId spans every account. It is recorded here only as sample context.
